component.name: Cereal
component.summary: AI meeting notepad: take notes, Cereal listens and writes them up

description.p: Jot down the few things that matter during a meeting. Cereal records your microphone and your speakers through PipeWire, so no bot joins the call, and transcribes both sides live. When the meeting ends, it turns your notes and the transcript into clean, structured notes.

ul.li: Live transcription with Deepgram, or locally with Whisper
Enhanced notes from templates, which you can edit
Ask questions about one meeting or all of them
An assistant for tasks, routines and follow-ups
Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or a local model through Ollama
Your notes stay on your computer. API keys live in a private file you edit yourself
